components.name: Play
components.description: Primary same-tab handoff. Label is always Play.
components.css: .ds-play { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #fff; background: #1a2e1a; border: 2px solid #3d5c3d; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-play:hover { background: #3d5c3d; border-color: #97752d; } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #97752d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Soundtrack
components.description: Secondary outbound YouTube control on the Play section.
components.css: .ds-soundtrack { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.6; color: #fff; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #3d5c3d; padding: 8px 16px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-soundtrack:hover { background: #1a2e1a; } .ds-soundtrack:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #97752d; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: Title screen for the blighted realm.
narrative.overview: The catalog landing is the Phaser remake’s frontispiece: dark BAM ground, cropped region art, pixel wordmark, one Play handoff. It is not a studio grid, not a résumé, and not the retired meadow marketing site.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed remake art with a left/bottom shade so type sits on the realm, not on a card
Press Start 2P for wordmark, titles, and Play; Public Sans for everything people read
Square pixel borders, no radius, gold only as accent
Soundtrack lives on Play as a quiet outbound button, never its own section

rules.name: The Realm Rule
rules.body: If the art were removed, the page should still read as Xal’s Path: forest-black, moss line, gold, pixel type.

rules.name: The No Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on BAM fields uses mist, not white/50.

rules.name: The Pixel Title Rule
rules.body: Wordmark, section titles, and Play use the display face. Nav anchors, body, hints, and footer use the readable face.

rules.name: The Close Rule
rules.body: Play is a handoff, not a restatement of Hero: same playUrl, hints, soundtrack, GitHub.

dos: Do vendor remake art under public/games/<slug>/ and let missing media fall back to a BAM field.
Do keep Game* components props-only; copy and URLs live in Content.
Do show mobileHint below 768px and desktopHint at 768px and up.
donts: Don't mention App Store, Google Play, Download, Intrigue, or X/Twitter.
Don't embed Phaser, iframe the game, or invent testimonials/store history.
Don't add a Music section or scroll-snap.
